summary: The selected divergence is not a missing zap.c:obj_resists call. The C recorder’s final rn2(100)=84 is consumed by invent.c:delobj after objnam.c:wizterrainwish changes the hero square to lava and calls trap.c:fire_damage_chain. The JavaScript lava-wish branch stopped at note_unported, so the floor scroll remained and the deletion resistance draw never occurred. Porting the whole chain restores both the burning message and the source-ordered rn2(100) draw.

source.behavior: Set gb.bhitpos to x,y; traverse the supplied nexthere pile when here is true or nobj chain otherwise; save the successor before fire_damage can unlink the current object; increment num only on a true fire_damage result; print You smell smoke when an object was destroyed while the hero is blind and couldsee is false; return num.
callerTrace: trap.c:4550-4573 defines the complete chain helper.
dig.c:869 calls it for floor objects after a hole or pit fills with lava; dighole and pit_flow are the production routes into liquid_flow.
mon.c:1059 calls it for a surviving, non-flying/non-lava-loving monster inventory after minliquid_core handles the lava damage.
objnam.c:3664 calls it for the floor chain after wizterrainwish changes terrain to lava and before returning from the wish.

JS adapters are js/dig.js:liquid_flow, js/mon.js:liquidDamageInventory, js/allmain.js:elapsedTurnMinLiquid, js/unported_monster_actions.js:planSimpleMonsterScan, and js/objnam_readobjnam.js:apply_wizterrainwish.
source.callee: trap.c:fire_damage is already ported in js/trap_water_damage.js and its return controls the destroyed-object count. It may consume random draws through zap.c:obj_resists inside invent.c:delobj; fire_damage_chain itself adds none. Floor deletion uses the existing mkobj.c remove_object owner.
